name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabs on Base UI's Tabs: a strip of tabs (underline or enclosed, two sizes, horizontal or vertical) with panels; tabs can carry a status icon, be closed with a button or Delete, and be reordered by drag or Alt+Shift+Arrow.
usage: Use Tabs to switch between views of the same place: the sections of a Settings dialog (variant line), or DBee's query tabs (variant enclosed, size sm). Compose it as Tabs (value, onValueChange) > TabsList > TabsTrigger per tab (value, icon for a status, children for the title) + TabsContent per tab. For closable tabs pass onClose on each TabsTrigger and keep the tabs in state (Tabs controlled): when the active tab closes, choose the next one. For reorderable tabs pass onReorder(value, index) on TabsList and move the tab in your array. For navigation between pages use NavigationMenu or Sidebar; for a choice that filters content in place, ToggleGroup.

props.name: value
props.description: Tabs: the active tab (controlled); defaultValue when uncontrolled. TabsTrigger and TabsContent: the tab they belong to.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Tabs: called when the user activates another tab.

props.name: variant
props.description: Tabs: an underline under the active tab, or editor-style enclosed tabs.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Tabs: the direction of the strip and of its arrow keys.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: TabsList: makes the tabs reorderable by drag and Alt+Shift+Arrow; move the tab to index.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: TabsList: as Base UI, activate a tab as soon as the arrow keys focus it.

props.name: icon
props.description: TabsTrigger: a leading status (running spinner, modified dot); give it a text alternative.

props.name: onClose
props.description: TabsTrigger: makes the tab closable (close button and Delete); focus moves to the neighbouring tab.

props.name: disabled
props.description: TabsTrigger: cannot be activated; shown in color.fg.disabled.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: TabsContent: keep the panel in the DOM while hidden (an editor's state).

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Wraps a tab and its close button; draggable when reorderable, with an accent line on the side a dragged tab will drop; data-slot="tabs-item".

slots.name: close
slots.description: The close button at a closable tab's end, out of the tab order and aria-hidden; data-slot="tabs-close".

parts.name: TabsList
parts.description: role="tablist"; scrolls when the tabs do not fit; onReorder makes the tabs movable.

parts.name: TabsTrigger
parts.description: role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls: icon, truncated title, and a close button when closable.

states.name: active
states.description: The active tab: color.fg.default, an accent underline (line) or color.bg.surface (enclosed).

states.name: hover
states.description: A tab under the pointer: color.fg.default (line) or color.interactive.hover (enclosed).

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width inside the tab.

states.name: closable
states.description: A closable tab leaves room for its close button.

states.name: dragging
states.description: The tab being dragged, at opacity.disabled.

states.name: drop-target
states.description: The tab a dragged tab will drop next to shows an accent line on that side.

accessibility: The strip is role="tablist" of role="tab" elements with aria-selected and aria-controls; each panel is role="tabpanel" labelled by its tab. Only the active tab is in the tab order.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (ArrowUp and ArrowDown when vertical), Home and End move between tabs; Enter or Space activates the focused tab (or focus activates it with activateOnFocus).

A closable tab closes with Delete when focused (aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"); its close button is for the pointer, out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology so the tablist holds only tabs. Focus moves to the neighbouring tab.
A reorderable tab moves with Alt+Shift+ArrowLeft and Alt+Shift+ArrowRight (Up and Down when vertical), announced through aria-keyshortcuts, as well as by drag, so reordering does not need a pointer.
A status icon needs a text alternative (role="img" with aria-label, or visually hidden text), since a coloured dot alone carries no meaning.
Only colours transition; nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.
